about.title: A studio built around <accent>fun-first gameplay</accent>
about.lead: NLDEVS creates replayable Fortnite maps with Unreal Editor for Fortnite — gun games, themed adventures, and progression-based experiences.
about.body: We focus on clean flow and strong replay value, whether you're grinding rounds, practicing aim, or just playing with friends.

why.title: Maps built to be <accent>played twice</accent>
why.description: We focus on replayability, clear objectives, and gameplay loops that hold up. If you like gun games, survival runs, and themed minigames, you'll fit right in.
why.reason1Desc: Islands built around repeatable loops — gun games, survival runs, and fast minigames that stay fun after the first match.
why.reason2Desc: Clean layouts and deliberate optimization so sessions stay smooth on every platform.
why.reason3Desc: Simple objectives and structured progression that keep players engaged and playing longer.
why.reason4Desc: Star Wars, TMNT, Squid-style minigames — each with its own strong visual identity.

home.schemaName: NLDEVS — UEFN Game Studio (Fortnite Experiences & Map Codes)
home.schemaDescription: NLDEVS is a UEFN game studio building Fortnite experiences. Explore our published games and get island codes, screenshots, and gameplay notes.
home.contractsBody: NLDEVS can help with UEFN map builds, branded experiences, gameplay systems, Verse/device work, in-game animations, and launch polish.
home.spotlightDescription: Quick rounds, strong themes, squad-friendly loops, and map systems that give players a reason to come back.
home.spotlightMapDescription: A coming soon tycoon experience with saved progress, heroes, sidekicks, workers, upgrades, and rebirth goals.
home.communityBody: Get map drops, playtest invites, Discord updates, and a closer look at what NLDEVS is building next.
home.communityNote: No spam. No selling info. Delete anytime.
home.featuredDescription: Explore live experiences and new launches. Tap a card for the full details, or copy the code and jump straight in.
home.updatesDescription: A quick pulse on active maps, community testing, and upcoming UEFN work.
home.update1Text: Sidekick Legends is being prepared as a longer-term progression map with heroes, workers, rebirths, and saved progress.
home.update2Text: Members can join the Discord to catch upcoming playtest calls, map drops, and quick patch notes.
home.update3Text: NLDEVS is testing new combat, bot-survival, city, and progression loops across current and future Fortnite islands.
home.reactionsDescription: Short, player-first feedback that matches what NLDEVS maps are designed to deliver.
home.reaction1Quote: Fast rounds, clean chaos, and easy to run back with a squad.
home.reaction2Quote: The 99 bots maps feel active right away. No waiting around.
home.reaction3Quote: Tycoon progression with saves is exactly the kind of map I come back to.
home.xpBody: Browse our best Fortnite XP maps and island codes to level up efficiently.
home.faq1Q: How do I play a Fortnite island code?
home.faq1A: Open Fortnite → Search/Discover, enter the island code (####-####-####), then join the island.
home.faq2Q: What are the best Fortnite XP maps?
home.faq2A: XP maps can change with updates and calibration. We maintain a curated list on our <link>Best Fortnite XP Maps</link> page.
home.faq2Plain: XP maps vary by update and calibration. We maintain a curated list of efficient XP maps on our Best Fortnite XP Maps page.
home.faq3Q: What is the newest NLDEVS Fortnite map?
home.faq3A: Our upcoming featured launch is <link>Star Wars Tycoon Sidekick Legends</link>, a coming soon Star Wars Tycoon map with Sidekick and Hero unlocks, new sections, workers, rebirth leaderboard climbing, auto-saving progress, and up to 4 players.
home.faq3Plain: Our upcoming featured launch is Star Wars Tycoon Sidekick Legends, a coming soon Star Wars Tycoon map with Sidekick and Hero unlocks, new sections, workers, rebirth leaderboard climbing, auto-saving progress, and up to 4 players.
home.faq4Q: Are these maps made with UEFN?
home.faq4A: Yes — our games are built with Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN) with a focus on replayability and fun gameplay loops.
home.notesTycoon: Coming soon: Star Wars Tycoon launch with Sidekick and Hero unlocks, new sections, workers, rebirth leaderboard climbing, auto-saving progress, and up to 4 players.
home.notesMegaRamp: High-speed ramp survival with TMNT vibes and replayable runs.
home.notesTmntCity: Explore a TMNT-themed city experience built in UEFN.
home.notesRvbSquid: Squid-style minigames with fast rounds and team chaos.
home.notesSquidRoyale: Open-world PvE survival with 99 bots, boss battles, new weapons, wildlife riding, ranks, leaderboards, and saved stats.
home.notesSidekickSiege: Sidekick-focused 99-bot survival with boss battles, PvE action, saved loadouts, ranks, leaderboards, and up to 5 players.
home.notesWinterfest: Holiday demon-hunting gun game with weapon rotations and repeat loops.
home.notesPlayersVsGuards: Team-based action with guards — good for longer sessions.
